replacement.title: Logo Text Content
replacement.definition: The logo must identify the business as Global Dough without the word Truck and retain the required Seriously Tasty Street Food strapline.

patches.decision_note: The company name and strapline can change independently of the logo's visual styling and are not represented by the current inventory.

replacement.title: Original Logo Artwork
replacement.definition: The final logo must be fresh, original artwork rather than copied or AI-generated artwork.

patches.decision_note: Artwork originality is an independent provenance constraint that can fail even when the visual composition is otherwise accepted.

replacement.title: Logo Usage Guidelines
replacement.definition: A separate document describing appropriate use of the logo, such as variations, spacing, minimum size, colours, typography, and usage rules.

patches.decision_note: The client requests logo guidelines, the freelancer identifies them as a separate deliverable, and the client then clarifies that comprehensive guidelines were not intended. This temporary lifecycle should not be collapsed into the colour and font Requirements.
Providing the variant package is a one-off delivery obligation. The primary logo's colour arrangement belongs to the visual-design Requirement rather than the variant inventory.

execution.observed_behavior: The client reports that only PNG logo 4 opens properly while the other PNG files do not display properly; the JPG and PDF files open successfully.

patches.decision_note: The PNG display problem is a concrete package failure. Inability to open AI, EPS, and PSD files without their required specialist applications does not itself establish defective deliverables.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer reports reviewing the PNG files and observing that the logos open correctly, with background-colour blending causing them to appear incorrectly displayed.

patches.decision_note: The source reports the freelancer's completed PNG review, but only recommends a browser or paint application for a future client check and does not verify that future check.
Substantive design feedback is contained in an unavailable attachment, so any additional visual-design modifications cannot be recovered safely from the supplied text.

Review the omitted proposal and agreement context to determine whether legal ownership transfer is a separate Requirement from preparation of the copyright certificate and whether the separate-charge dispute created a material ambiguity.
